items.headline: Australia and Solomon Islands Sign Security Pact Excluding Foreign Bases
items.summary: On November 25, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese and Solomon Islands Prime Minister Matthew Wale signed a new bilateral security treaty in Canberra. The agreement establishes Australia as the island nation's primary security partner and explicitly bans foreign military bases, marking a significant diplomatic shift in the South Pacific.

items.headline: China Launches Shenzhou-24 Spacecraft Carrying Pakistan's First Astronaut
items.summary: China successfully launched the Shenzhou-24 crewed spacecraft on Wednesday to send a three-person crew to the Tiangong space station. The flight marks a milestone in space cooperation as Pakistani astronaut Muhammad Zeeshan Ali became the first foreign national to board China's orbital outpost.

items.headline: Baltimore Orioles Sign Pitcher Freddy Peralta to Record $125 Million Deal
items.summary: The Baltimore Orioles officially announced a five-year, $125 million contract with right-handed starting pitcher Freddy Peralta. This historic signing marks the largest financial commitment to a pitcher in the franchise's history.

items.headline: Tidal Becomes First Major Music Streamer to Ban Fully AI-Generated Songs
items.summary: Music streaming service Tidal announced a total ban on songs created entirely by artificial intelligence and plans to remove up to 29 million AI-generated tracks from its platform. The company made the decision after discovering that over 40 percent of recent music uploads were fully synthetic, making it the first major streaming app to enact such a policy.
